title: Barbra Streisand Back To Broadway 1993 Sony Music Entertainment Inc Columbia CD
descriptionText: The Barbra Streisand "Back To Broadway" CD, released in 1993 under Sony Music Entertainment Inc's Columbia label, features the iconic artist's vocal talents in a collection of popular songs. This album showcases Streisand's incredible voice and style, making it a must-have for fans of pop and vocal music. With English lyrics and a timeless sound, this CD is a classic addition to any music collection, offering a nostalgic trip back to the Broadway stage of the 1990s.
